claim_scope: Split-integrity attestation and leak-free re-baselining for the Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer scratch-hardness benchmark ONLY, normalized feature domain [0,1]^4. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. Does not modify or delete any existing receipt; it supersedes the MAGNITUDES those receipts report and leaves their qualitative conclusions standing. Intervals are marginal, not family-conditional. n=58 leak-free observations from a single formulator and a single instrument; Phase-1 would still require a cross-formulator dataset and independent wet-lab validation.

dataset_structure_finding.note: Exactly one formulation (Vernetzung 0.697303, HDI-IPDI 0.711274, Mattierungsmittel 0.576461, Pigmentpaste 0.191029) carries two distinct Kratzhaerte values (16.765, 13.994) -- the only genuine measurement replicate in the corpus; both are retained and both fall in the same leak-free fold.

honest_interpretation: SPLIT-INTEGRITY DEFECT FOUND AND QUANTIFIED. The three Purformance iteration workbooks are cumulative campaign snapshots, not disjoint batches: all 27 of iteration 2's (feature,target) rows recur VERBATIM inside iteration 3, so the 86 stacked rows hold only 58 unique observations. Under the leave-one-iteration-out split used by this module's three prior receipts, 27/27 held-out iteration-2 rows and 27/42 held-out iteration-3 rows are byte-identical to rows in their own training set. This run first reproduces every published parent number exactly (all_parent_numbers_reproduced=True), then re-runs the identical arms, metrics and bootstraps under a leak-free protocol assigning each unique observation to its FIRST iteration of appearance (disjoint folds 17/26/15, verified zero shared feature vectors across folds). Point R2 legacy -> leak-free: Guth-Gold 0.3345 -> 0.2437; linear-4 0.3341 -> 0.2067; Box-Wilson quadratic RSM 0.4668 -> 0.0759; default HistGBM 0.3857 -> -0.0469. Directional concordance C legacy -> leak-free: Guth-Gold 0.7211 -> 0.7111; linear-4 0.7226 -> 0.7129; RSM 0.7500 -> 0.7076; default HistGBM 0.7237 -> 0.5557. Inflation scales monotonically with model flexibility: the 5-parameter physical law loses 0.0908 R2, the 15-parameter response surface 0.3909, the gradient-boosted ensemble 0.4326. WHAT SURVIVES: the Einstein-Guth-Gold physical law is still the best of the six arms on leak-free point R2 (yes), and its leak-free directional concordance C=0.7111 has cluster-bootstrap CI [0.6155, 0.7980], which EXCLUDES chance (0.5). WHAT DOES NOT SURVIVE: at n=58 unique observations the paired 95% CI for Guth-Gold minus constant-mean on R2 is [-0.0224, 0.5675] (INCLUDES zero) and for Guth-Gold minus the declared fit-free Wicks-Jones-Pappas Rule-1 baseline on concordance is [-0.0019, 0.2144] (INCLUDES zero). The CORROBORATED significance verdict receipted in directional-concordance-v1 was carried by duplicated rows; on leak-free data the same comparison is UNDERPOWERED and the significance claim is hereby WITHDRAWN. The point estimates still favour the physical law, but the evidence no longer clears 95%. STRONGEST NEW NEGATIVE RESULT: out-of-box gradient boosting retains essentially no out-of-sample skill once duplicates are removed -- R2 -0.0469 against a constant-mean baseline of -0.0535 (i.e. it explains no variance at all), and its directional concordance falls from 0.7237 to 0.5557 with CI [0.4917, 0.6113], which INCLUDES chance. Its entire apparent advantage was memorization of duplicated rows. This is a verified instance of Kaufman-Rosset-Perlich 2012 leakage and supplies a concrete mechanism for the parent Purformance model card's unreproducible tuned R2=0.8555, which no honest group-safe protocol in this module has ever approached. Hostile-null y-shuffle under the leak-free protocol collapses the physical arm to R2=-0.1855 and C=0.4991 (chance), confirming no residual exchangeability leakage. NET EFFECT ON THE MODULE: the magnitudes AND the significance verdicts of guth-gold-physical-baseline-v1, directional-concordance-v1 and alt-reinforcement-law-v1 are superseded by the DEDUP column here; the qualitative ordering physics >= linear > out-of-box ML is preserved and strengthened, while the physics-beats-Rule-1 significance claim is withdrawn pending more data. The binding constraint is now sample size, not model form.
